b) Reference: the plate is about 2.5 times the width of the rice mound and the rice spans roughly 45% of the plate width. There is no fork or spoon for scale, so I rely on the type cue.

Bulk density 0.8 g/ml gives about 270 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no base layer is visible beneath the rice. A loose mound on a plate, so no extra items.

STEP 5 - Rice, cooked, white: about 130 kcal per 100 g.
